path.style: fill: none; stroke: var(--muted); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 3 2.5; stroke-linecap: round

text.style: font: 700 24px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; fill: var(--fg)
font: 400 14px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; fill: var(--muted)
font: 700 14px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; fill: var(--accent)
